observations.body: On the first day of the week disciples gather to break bread, Paul speaks until midnight, Eutychus falls and is taken up dead, Paul embraces him, breaks bread, continues talking, and the young man is brought alive.
observations.label: Breaking bread frames an all-night gathering and restored life
